why_it_looked_open: An independent ComputerInfo reading peaked at 5.01 GB about 2 seconds before the recipe probe, which then sampled 4.76 GiB. The physical figure fluctuates around the threshold on this machine.

consequences.reason: launch-owned rejects an existing receipt; a later attempt needs a new frozen v9 with the same sources.

control: Not controllable by the agent: the shortfall is the user's resident applications (about 27 GiB of 31.77 GiB). Lowering the gate is not permitted by the project rules.
next: Free roughly 0.5 GiB (or more), then freeze v9 with the same sources and run once; alternatively run the runtime sampling session while the game is in a loaded level.
